title: Conduent to Report Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 5, 2026
summary: Conduent Incorporated (Nasdaq: CNDT), a global technology-enabled operating partner, plans to report its third-quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, November 5 after market close. ...
body_markdown:
[Conduent Incorporated](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.conduent.com&esheet=54629399&newsitemid=20261027677604&lan=en-US&anchor=Conduent+Incorporated&index=1&md5=05e78bf144e7014ea1cd037a950c3f04) (Nasdaq: CNDT), a global technology-enabled operating partner, plans to report its third-quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, November 5 after market close. Management will present the results during a conference call and webcast at 4:30 p.m. ET.


The call will be available by live audiocast along with the news release and online presentation slides at[https://investor.conduent.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.conduent.com&esheet=54629399&newsitemid=20261027677604&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.conduent.com&index=2&md5=943461d2b85033875482dbebaa9a2b02)


The conference call will also be available by calling 800-717-1738 toll free. The international dial-in is +1-646 307 1865. If requested, the conference ID is 13763477.


A recording of the conference call with be available by calling 877-660-6853 or 201-612-7415 after the conference call concludes. The access ID for the recording is 13763477.


The call recording will be available until November 19, 2026.


We look forward to your participation.


**About Conduent**
Conduent is a global technology-enabled operating partner that helps businesses and governments simplify complexity, modernize mission-critical operations and deliver measurable outcomes through AI, automation, data and human expertise. Learn more at[www.conduent.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.conduent.com&esheet=54629399&newsitemid=20261027677604&lan=en-US&anchor=www.conduent.com&index=3&md5=c408b827b364a42c86e44055f798a107) .
